fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields (from meta tags + schema.org microdata, this site has no JSON-LD NewsArticle block); latest-mode records (site RSS feed) carry title/link-style teaser fields. The site is bilingual Russian/Kyrgyz; content is passed through in whichever language it was published, not translated.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek, from <meta name="description"> (article mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from paragraph tags inside div.cont[itemprop=articleBody] (article mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from <meta name="author">, when present (article mode only) -- genuinely absent (no tag at all) on some articles, e.g. some Kyrgyz-language pieces.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp with timezone offset, from the <meta property="article:published_time"> tag (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified timestamp with timezone offset, from <meta property="article:modified_time"> (article mode only).

section.title: Section
section.description: Site section/category name, from <meta property="article:section"> (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, from <meta property="og:image"> (article mode only).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Raw comma-separated keywords string from <meta name="keywords"> (article mode only).

_lang.title: Language
_lang.description: Per-article language code read from the page's <html lang=".."> attribute ("ru" or "ky") -- more reliable than the site's og:locale meta tag, which is hardcoded ru_ru site-wide even on Kyrgyz-language pages (article mode only).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC 822 publish timestamp as given by the feed (latest mode).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: Feed item <guid> -- same as the article URL on this site (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
